create_tokenized_dataset: create a tokenized dataset in MongoDB with a given name and vocabulary
add_train_trace: add a tokenized trace to the training set of a tokenized dataset
drop_dataset: drop a tokenized dataset and all its collections from MongoDB
list_token_datasets: list all tokenized dataset names stored in MongoDB
tokenize_trace: tokenize a TokenizedTrace into AStarTrace tensors using a DictTokenizer
